analysis.description: The paper introduces PID TD Learning and PID Q-Learning algorithms which accelerate the convergence of Temporal Difference learning methods by integrating Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) controller ideas from control theory. It addresses the issue of slow convergence in long-horizon tasks for conventional RL algorithms by providing both theoretical analysis and empirical validation of these new algorithms.

type.justification: The paper focuses on introducing new algorithms and analyzing their theoretical properties and convergence rates, with a significant portion dedicated to theoretical derivations.
type.quote: We give a theoretical analysis of the convergence of PID TD Learning and its acceleration compared to the conventional TD Learning.
